Dialog.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Dialog.Name: Eeva
Dialog.Text: Good sun to you, Aisling. Say! *leans over the counter* What do you think of my hair?

Dialog.Text: Ah! An honest Aisling! I like you already.

Dialog.Name: Eeva
Dialog.Text: I've been watching tenants coming in and leaving, and I've narrowed the selections down to a few styles I really want to try. But I need some items...and as you know, I can't very well leave my inn abandoned.

Sorry, I have bigger things to worry about.

Dialog.Text: Thank you so much! Now...which do you like best?
